title: OOP: Designing Base Agent & Tool Classes
why: Major agent frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen) are heavily object-oriented. Understanding abstract base classes, inheritance, and encapsulation allows you to build custom agents and interchangeable tools.
objectives: Design abstract BaseTool and BaseAgent classes
Use polymorphism to swap LLM providers seamlessly
Manage internal agent state and memory using class attributes
concept: By creating a base Tool class, any new tool created by your team automatically conforms to the schema expected by your agent runner loop.

practice.description: Create a WikipediaSearchTool subclass inheriting from BaseTool that mocks search functionality.
practice.hint:
Set 
ame and description attributes and override the 
un method.

requirements: Implement Agent class that accepts a list of BaseTool instances
Build a get_tools_prompt() method returning markdown descriptions of all loaded tools

mistakes: Hardcoding tool execution inside agent loops instead of using polymorphic tool objects
